test_mode: Blinded asynchronous read of canonical prepared answers; no ending supplied. PNG pages 07 and 10 visually inspected after ballot lock.
experience: The grievances made me sympathize with Tess and Paige before the access evidence arrived. I liked discovering that sincere emotional reasons to resent Grant were shared widely, then letting the records redirect my suspicion. By the final round the accusation was a clean intersection of three facts.

fun.detail: Strong character grievances and gentle art puns support a social dinner. The method round feels more like sorting a grid than interrogating people, but the decisive evidence is satisfying.

navigation.assessment: Clear round headings, named ask groups, choose-next directions and STOP footers. Visually verified both IF INNOCENT and IF MURDERER labels on pages 07 and 10; neither is missing.
navigation.limitation: No physical page handling or live round timing tested.

question_matching.assessment: Every transcript question addressed a name in its printed group and the corresponding answer supplied the requested facts. No mismatch found.
examples: Frank's display-change grievance answers the display question.
The Method question requests cleaning material and its purpose; the answer gives linen and wiping a display bracket.

repetition.assessment: Opportunity and Method use nearly identical sentence structures across 16 answers. This supports fair comparison but reduces character voice and listening surprise.
exact_quotes: I went into the Donor Salon at 6:36
That was what the materials desk issued me.

sixteen_present_vs_thirty_listed.assessment: Instructions correctly say 'Ignore absent guests.' Identity provides the 16 attendees, while the ask sheets include 30 total names. This caused a scanning task, not a blocker. Arrival explicitly permits discussing Minnie with anyone because she is absent.
sixteen_present_vs_thirty_listed.improvement: Have the host mark absent names once or provide a compact attending-name roster for this configuration.

note_space.assessment: Page 07 visibly has a 'Notes from this round' heading and two horizontal ruled lines. Page 10 has no notes area and uses its space for two answer boxes plus turn instructions. Two lines seem tight for comparing 16 people, especially time, key and material.
note_space.limitation: No handwriting or physical note taking tested.

memory_load.assessment: The animal comparison was unambiguous: IGUANA versus twice-announced HIPPO. The transcript allowed rereading names and facts, so this test cannot establish human memory performance. Tracking 16 named answers would be a substantial live listening demand without a grid.
memory_load.exact_quote: The host keeps track so everybody is heard.

branch_safety.assessment: Correct branch selected throughout. Both branches are visible together on the same answer pages; headings and separate blue boxes make selection clear. Arrival tells players to keep role private and Method repeats the preparation records.
actual_disclosures: I saw my own alternate murderer branch, including the 6:46 salon time, because it is printed on my supplied answer page.
No other guest's role label or alternate branch was disclosed in the public table transcript.
The selected animal HIPPO was intentionally announced; no public animal-to-character mapping was provided.
hypothetical_risks: A player could accidentally read the alternate box or its label aloud; that did not occur in this canonical read.
A neighbor could see a branch while handling a shared packet; physical handling was not tested.

roleplay.assessment: The arrival tasks and grievances give Frank a reason to talk and care. The emotional pull toward Tess and Paige was credible, while the evidence ruled them out. Acting is explicitly optional, which reduces pressure. Live improvisation, interpersonal flow and social tasks were not tested.
roleplay.exact_quote: Acting is optional; these printed facts are enough.

deduction.assessment: Elon uniquely combines post-cleaning salon entry, logged key access before the missing sample, and gold-seamed linen. F4 and F5 explicitly close transfer loopholes, so the final conclusion is highly constrained.

prioritized_changes.change: Add a separate compact comparison sheet with attendee names and columns for salon entry, key and material, plus motive notes.
prioritized_changes.evidence: Page 07's 'Notes from this round' provides two ruled lines; Method contains 16 three-field preparation records.

prioritized_changes.change: Keep the three comparison facts standardized but let the ordinary errand sentence carry slightly more character voice.
prioritized_changes.evidence: Repeated 'That was what the materials desk issued me.' makes 16 otherwise distinctive characters sound alike.

prioritized_changes.change: Provide an attending-only roster or host-marked absent names alongside the ask pages.
prioritized_changes.evidence: 'Ignore absent guests.' works, but the 30 printed names still require checking against the 16 attendees.
